meta.name: blog-post
meta.description: 杂志感长文, 含 masthead、hero、figures、pull quote、作者署名

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带杂志排版的长篇图文内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写并发布具有专业杂志风格的长篇文章。
copy.tagline_en: Generate long-form content with magazine-style layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write and publish long articles with professional magazine styling.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按杂志长文模板生成 600 字以上的文章页面,含 masthead、hero(大标题、副标、作者署名、阅读时间)、单栏正文、作者简介卡片和相关文章卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求写博客长文、散文或案例研究这类长文章时触发,产出的排版以文字为主。

say.text: 写一篇 600 字以上的博客长文,主题是远程办公
say.note: 会生成带 masthead 和署名的长页面

say.text: 把这篇文章排成杂志感长文,加一段 pull quote
say.note: 正文里会插入大号衬线斜体引言块

say.text: 给这篇长文补上作者简介卡片和相关文章
say.note: 末尾会加上作者卡片和三张相关文章卡

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces magazine-style long-form pages of 600+ words: masthead, hero with title, subtitle, byline and read time, a single-column body with figures and pull quotes, an author bio card and related posts.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a blog post, essay or case study long-form article; the layout is typography-led.

say_en.text: Write a 600-word blog post about remote work
say_en.note: Produces a long page with masthead and byline

say_en.text: Lay this article out as a magazine-style long read with a pull quote
say_en.note: Adds a large serif italic quote block

say_en.text: Add an author bio card and related posts to this article
say_en.note: Appends a bio card and three related cards
